description: This script generates PEM files with various certificate authority key identifier data, including valid, invalid, and extra content cases, using base64 encoding and subprocess calls to convert ASCII to DER format.

methods.name: Ascii2Der
methods.description: Converts ASCII text to DER format using the ascii2der external tool.

methods.name: MakePemBlock
methods.description: Creates a PEM formatted block with base64-encoded DER data.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a PEM file with specified DER text, converting ASCII to DER and wrapping in PEM format.
